title: VPC incremental runtime migration with transactional snapshot + synthetic health assertions
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Problem: Private (VPC) customers require automated runtime/data-plane upgrades that guarantee zero-downtime and strong rollback semantics. Current approaches either (a) accept short disruptions when swapping runtime binaries or (b) rely on fragile manual interventions to restore KV/cache consistency after a faulty rollout. This ticket defines a staged, Terraform-driven migration flow that uses transactional snapshots, shadow priming, synthetic health assertions, and automatic rollback triggers to reduce blast radius and support safe unattended upgrades.

Goal: Provide a repeatable, auditable upgrade flow for Private deployments that: 1) performs rolling upgrades without user-visible errors or increased 95/99 latency SLO violations; 2) ensures KV/cache consistency for in-flight sessions by using snapshot-and-replay or shadow-warm techniques; 3) supports instant automated rollback to previous runtime with a verified data-plane state; 4) integrates with our IaC (Terraform modules) so customers can opt into the safer path by flipping config flags.

Scope/Constraints: This work focuses on the runtime/data-plane control loop and orchestration lived in the Private operator + Terraform modules. It does NOT change hosted API behavior or pricing. Work must be compatible with on-prem air-gapped installs and AWS VPC installs. Rollout orchestration must be idempotent and resilient to control-plane clients disconnecting mid-rollout.

Proposed approach (high level):
- Preflight: Terraform plan validation + operator precondition checks (node resource headroom, disk, network routes, KMS accessible).
- Transactional snapshot: Before upgrading a slice, take a consistent KV/cache snapshot and write to a versioned, immutable store (S3-compatible or local snapshot storage per customer).
- Shadow priming: Start a parallel upgraded runtime in shadow mode and replay the snapshot + a short window of recent writes to warm caches and validate correctness without taking user traffic.
- Synthetic health assertions: Run a suite of synthetic, deterministic probes (tokenized inference, KV read/write, session affinity assertions, tail-latency probes) against the shadow instance; compute pass/fail and confidence score.
- Canary shift: If shadow passes, shift a small percentage of real traffic via the router to the upgraded slice with request mirroring and header tags; monitor latency, error rate, and model output quality metrics.
- Automated rollback gating: Define gating rules (error budget, latency regressions, quality thresholds derived from eval prompts). If gating fails, automatically shift traffic back and trigger snapshot-based restore for slices that attempted state mutations.
- Final cutover: Gradual scale-up and finalize terraform state to mark new runtime as primary; keep snapshot retention policy and allow point-in-time restore for a configurable period.

Why this is different: Instead of purely draining + swap we use snapshot-shadow-validate-replay which reduces time windows where user sessions might observe inconsistent behavior and gives a deterministic rollback path backed by immutable snapshots.

acceptance_criteria: Operator supports 'snapshot-and-shadow' rollout mode settable from Terraform module flag
Preflight checks fail noisy upgrades and provide clear failure reasons in console and CLI
Shadow instance can be primed from transactionally-consistent snapshot and passes synthetic health assertions in >95% of test runs
Canary traffic mirror shows no >2x increase in 95p latency and error rate stays within configured threshold during validation window
Automated rollback restores previous runtime state from snapshot within configured RTO (target 3 minutes for single slice) and logs reconciliation events
End-to-end e2e test harness reproduces a failed upgrade, triggers rollback, and validates session continuity post-rollback
tasks: Design Terraform flag and module changes (ilm_snapshot_rollout boolean + config block)
Extend operator API: /rollout start payload includes snapshotRetention, shadowResources, gating thresholds
Implement snapshot manager: create, list, immutable store hooks, retention policy
Implement shadow priming flow in operator: start node in shadow, replay snapshot + tail logs
Create synthetic probe suite and baseline metrics for typical workloads
Wire telemetry: add rollout tracing events and per-slice gating metrics to Console
Add automatic rollback implementation: traffic reversion + snapshot restore + reconciliation
Write Terraform integration tests and local e2e scenario for on-prem and AWS VPC
Draft runbook and add to oncall playbooks including manual rollback steps and diagnostics
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: Kickoff meeting with infra, operator, and console teams. Agreed on snapshot store interface and gating metrics schema (Ava, Liam, Priya).

2025-02-26: Operator PR opened to add 'shadow' replica mode. Shadow mode can start and bind to snapshot store (PR #412).
2025-03-01: Synthetic probe harness MVP completed; runs against local dev cluster. Baseline 95p latency recorded for standard 2k token prompt.
2025-03-03: First integration run in staging encountered failure: tail replay ordering bug caused inconsistent cache state. Root cause identified and fix planned (ENG-412371 created).
